instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot. Inside a martial arts gym with grey padded walls, the man in the black t-shirt and shorts (R1) stands on the left in a defensive stance. He faces right, wearing white shin guards and black gloves. The shirtless man with a mullet and gold-patterned shorts (R2) lunges forward from the right, throwing a punch with his white-gloved hand toward R1. In the background, two male bystanders stand watching near camera tripods. The scene is lit by even overhead gym lighting, casting soft shadows on the grey floor.
